carousel_caption:
Your reel gets judged in 3 seconds. Instagram now shows you how many people skip it in that time.

In January 2025, Instagram's head Adam Mosseri said the top three ranking signals are watch time, likes and sends. In August 2025, Instagram added two Reels insights: a retention chart ("the flatter the line, the more engaged your audience is") and skip rate, the share of views from people who skip your reel in the first 3 seconds.

So the first line matters most. Write it in four parts: say what most people do, add one true proof, promise one thing, and ask a question you answer at the end. Then compare your skip rate with your last 5 reels.

Send this to a creator whose reels keep getting skipped, and save it for your next hook.
